inventoryNote: Earlier unselected runs used 13,574 nodes / 23,068 edges; selected follow-ups and final runs use 13,574 nodes / 23,073 edges. Each case records counts. Final old/new selected comparison has identical index/planned hashes.

comparisonBeforeUnselected.method: Real browser RAF; 24 sinusoidal wheel-input zoom frames across LOD thresholds; actual requested 600ms focus/fit animations measured through their exact final target and paint (10s timeout); 24 native PointerEvent hover positions with exact hit testing; all 13,574 nodes and 23,068 edges loaded, all 13 fields/planned/definitions enabled. Oversized DPR2 uses full-resolution direct fallback. Additional settled-raster latency and final draw costs are reported separately. CPU submission time and browser frame cadence use performance.now after callbacks, including the final drained paint, rather than pre-paint RAF timestamps. No universal-device performance claim.
